limitations.statement: FLEURS publishes no speaker ids; its TSVs give only a gender per recording. Speaker disjointness between the dev (calibration) and test (confirmation) splits cannot be verified, and neither can a speaker count: family and script disjointness hold, speaker disjointness is assumed, not shown.

Units carry the speaker '<language>:fleurs-unidentified', a lower bound on the speaker count: FLEURS collects each locale separately, so recordings of different languages cannot share a speaker. The policy minimum of 3 speakers is therefore met only by covering at least 3 languages.

strata.reason: Error rates differ by language: word against character units and each recognizer's quality per language (clean N2 95th percentile: 0.037 in it to 0.14 in ja; 13% of ja above the pooled 0.094).
